classes.description: AQL Level — AQL检验水平/等级。定义检验的严格程度标准（如 Level I, Level II, Level III, S-1 等），包含特定抽样方案的明细配置。 【Swagger】Schema: AQLLevelEntity；来源文件: AQLLevels.json；API: /api/AQLLevels。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: name
properties.description: 检验水平/等级的唯一名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 → ChangeStatus 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

classes.description: Sample Size Detail — 样本量明细条目。存储特定AQL水平和样本量字码下的样本量(sampleSize)、接收判定数(accepts) and 拒收判定数(rejects)。 【Swagger】Schema: SampleSizeDetailsChanges；来源文件: AQLLevels.json；API: /api/AQLLevels。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: accepts
properties.description: 接收数 (Ac，判定合格的最多不良样本数) 【Swagger】The number of rejects allowed and still accept

properties.name: sampleSize
properties.description: 样本量（必填，对应字码的实际抽样样本数） 【Swagger】The sample size associated with the SampleSizeCode

properties.name: sampleSizeCode
properties.description: 样本量字码（必填，如 A, B, C, D 等） 【Swagger】The Sample Size Code for the assoctiated Container Qty Range defined in the Inspection Level

properties.name: rejects
properties.description: 拒收数 (Re，判定不合格的最低不良样本数，必填) 【Swagger】The number ot failed samples to rejects the Container on. The container will be rejected if the the number of samples rejected >= Rejects
